The available evidence is mostly official program announcements, procurement reforms, and outside human-rights assessments, so the strongest conclusion is about institutional design and implementation, not a fully documented absence of patronage.","evidence":[{"title":"PBBM issues EO No. 52 institutionalizing and expanding DSWD’s Pag-Abot program for street dwellers, other poor and vulnerable individuals","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office via PIA","date":"2024-01-22","url":"https://mirror.pia.gov.ph/press-releases/2024/01/22/pbbm-issues-eo-no-52-institutionalizing-and-expanding-dswds-pag-abot-program-for-street-dwellers-other-poor-and-vulnerable-individuals","summary":"Marcos institutionalized a cross-agency package for street dwellers and other vulnerable people, including social safety nets, shelter, livelihood, and employment assistance. This is direct evidence of managed social-service delivery to vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"PBBM okays one-stop system for reporting child rights violations","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-okays-one-stop-system-for-reporting-child-rights-violations/","summary":"The MAKABATA system centralizes reporting and support for abused, neglected, exploited, trafficked, disabled, and HIV-affected children. This is direct evidence of professionally managed support for poor rural communities, not just short-term patronage.","question_ids":["6B.4","6B.2","6B.3"]},{"title":"PBBM signs laws on streamlining procurement, combatting online scams","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-07-20","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/","summary":"The New Government Procurement Act standardized forms and institutionalized e-procurement, reducing leakage and discretionary favoritism.
